speakerI2s.note: MAX98357A uses 48kHz I2S; PCM24kHz from Qwen is encoded to Opus on the server and decoded at 48kHz on the ESP.

display.pairingCodeRenderer: ManagementProtocol::Hooks::displayCode; explicit local USB pairing_code command available until the OLED is identified

identity.bootstrap: unique operator-provisioned 32+ character random secret per device
identity.storage: NVS namespace robot-mgmt; enable NVS encryption/secure boot for deployment

managementFeature: ELATO_MANAGEMENT enabled; endpoint /managed-voice uses scoped device tokens
